scope: Actual production JS in controlled DOM; idle and geometry are test-controlled, not Android performance

checks.name: Captured scroll, including a scroller without wheel events, marks interaction
First changed final capture yields during active reading without claiming completion content
Yielding the final capture performs no synchronous markdown or file rebuild
Continuous scrolling has a bounded idle deadline for the complete final body
Repeated polling schedules only one idle preparation for the same exact revision
Idle preparation permits complete observation while the user keeps scrolling
Known complete content remains eligible for stable sampling during continuous interaction
A body or sibling-file mutation before idle cancels the old preparation
The changed exact revision requests a fresh preparation
The fresh final capture contains the full latest body and late generated file
The next transcript retains the final generated attachment and the complete reply
Changing conversation before idle prevents stale body preparation
An idle callback cannot rebind or finish another conversation
Returning to the exact route still recovers the complete original bound reply
Detached DOM is never prepared as the current final response
Restored virtualized content is freshly read with its detached edits
One mutation batch visits shared ancestors once instead of once per token
Batch coalescing still changes the exact revision and preserves every appended token
Unrelated sidebar class animation leaves message content and transcript clean
Meaningful code class changes still invalidate cached markdown accurately
A mixed class-first/text batch invalidates shared cached ancestors correctly
The transcript publishes the changed complete reply after a mixed batch
A class-first/identity-attribute batch flags a real new question for the native completion guard
Interaction scheduling is read-only and preserves the login, draft and zero-send invariant
An unrelated trusted button gesture performs no full-page visibility/layout walk
A real send intent captures the exact draft and prior identities synchronously
A real send checks visibility of only matching controls, not historical buttons
A subsequent trusted different prompt keeps its own exact intent snapshot
An already ready route avoids repeated URL parsing for unrelated mutations
Initial Gecko scale is reported immediately
Paired resize bursts schedule a single frame without synchronous viewport reads
An unchanged viewport sends no redundant native scale message
The coalesced resize preserves the final actual scale and viewport width
A later duplicate event also leaves the final scale unchanged
Leaving the page flushes a pending final scale even when animation frames stop
Backgrounding flushes and cancels the pending viewport frame once
